title: Catholic, Protestant, and Orthodox Branches — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: Christianity's three great branches, Catholic, Protestant, and Eastern Orthodox, differ on authority, tradition, and sacraments. The Catholic Church is the largest single denomination, with more than a billion members. This overview edition presents Catholic, Protestant, and Orthodox Branches within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.

spec.overview: Christianity's three great branches, Catholic, Protestant, and Eastern Orthodox, differ on authority, tradition, and sacraments. The Catholic Church is the largest single denomination, with more than a billion members.
sacred_texts: Shared Bible; differing canons and confessions
practices: Mass, Divine Liturgy, or worship services by branch
holidays: Shared Christmas and Easter with calendar differences
spec.adherents: Catholicism is the largest branch, followed by Protestantism and Orthodoxy.

example.fact: Ecumenical dialogue has grown steadily since the twentieth century.

spec.study_note: Core facts verified from public sources; adherent figures are estimates from the Pew Research Center.
